prompt:

Preserve exact source layout: two lamps stacked vertically on the same upright pole; red upper signal is offset LEFT of the pole, gray footplate under the pole, narrow ladder farther RIGHT. True orthographic principal views, no perspective or isometric.

TOP: camera directly above. The lamp housings are horizontal barrels pointing forward; show the dark gray rounded barrel ROOFS aligned on the same axis, with the red lens visible only as a very thin edge at the forward-facing end. Do NOT show the round red lens face from above. Keep upper red lamp occluding the lower green lamp in the aligned footprint; do not place red and green lamps side by side. Include the centered pole cap and the ladder's thin right-side footprint.
BOTTOM: camera directly below. Show the lamp underside as a small dark circular/rounded footprint at LEFT of the pole if it overhangs the base, the square/rounded footplate centered under the POLE (not under the lamp), and the ladder continuing farther RIGHT. Preserve the native offsets and full XY envelope. Do not move base under the lamp and do not show glowing frontal lens faces. Crisp source-matching pixel art, transparent margin, no guides/labels/clipping.
